# Vendored third-party assets

- `toastui-editor-all.min.js` — TOAST UI Editor 3.2.2 (MIT, UICDN all-in-one build):
  https://github.com/nhn/tui.editor — MIT license; includes bundled ProseMirror and DOMPurify.
- `toastui-editor.css`, `toastui-editor-viewer.css`, `theme/toastui-editor-dark.css` — editor/viewer styles (MIT).
- `toastui-editor-viewer.js` / `toastui-editor.css` npm-dist copies kept only for reference; do NOT load them
  (they need external prosemirror globals — use toastui-editor-all.min.js).
